subject: Quantilus Dedicated: OEM & Cloud capacity harmonization
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@arc-gpu.com>, cloud-ops@acmecloud.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Quantilus Dedicated: OEM & Cloud capacity harmonization

Hi Lisa / ACME cloud team —

Quick context: Quantilus is targeting a mid-March production onramp for a Dedicated pool (initial commit: ~96 A100-equivalent GPUs) tied to their annual contract (DEAL-78924). Sales/CS asked me to coordinate OEM lead times + cloud reservation handshake so we can give them a realistic go-live date.

What we need from you this week:
- Lisa: can you confirm current OEM SKU lead times and whether we can get a partial ship (staggered racks) to hit an earlier ramp? Please include serial ETA variance, any minimum order constraints, and firmness of price/availability if we lock within 30 days.
- ACME cloud: can your capacity team hold a soft reservation for the region (us-west-2) that would cover peak burst for the first 90 days, and confirm latency-to-GPU topology so we can map routing? Also need your regional SKUs and the committed-rate quote we would put in the contract.

I've attached a one-pager timeline (quantilus_milestones.xlsx) and a draft capacity split proposal. If we can't get OEM ETA under 8 weeks, we'll need to run a bridge plan: reserved cloud + temporary lower-precision model variant.

Next steps: short sync (30m) Wednesday with OEM + Cloud + Procurement to align on dates. Proposed times: Wed 13th 10:00 PST or 15:00 PST. Let me know what works.

Thanks,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
c: +1-415-555-0187

Attachment: quantilus_milestones.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@arc-gpu.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, cloud-ops@acmecloud.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quantilus Dedicated: OEM & Cloud capacity harmonization

Connor —

Thanks for the heads-up. Current status from OEM side:
- SKU: ARC-A100X-48 (unit = rack of 8 cards). Standard lead time is 9–11 weeks from PO (factory slot dependent).
- We can offer staggered fulfillment: first partial rack ship at ~6 weeks, but it requires a 20% expedite surcharge and a minimum of 2 racks to start staging.
- Prices hold for 21 days from quote; we can extend to 30 days with a deposit.

I'll attach the SKU and leadtime PDF after I pull the latest pricing. Quick ask: if you need an earlier hard ETA, can Redwood confirm which metal (2 vs 4 racks) is acceptable as bridge capacity? That affects what we can commit to.

Lisa
Lisa Chang
Strategic Accounts, Arc GPUs
Attachment: OEM_SKU_and_leadtimes.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 08:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quantilus Dedicated: OEM & Cloud capacity harmonization

Connor / Neha —

I can join the Wed 13th, 10:00 PST slot. From procurement perspective:
- We need SKU-level quotes for PO and the exact expedite surcharge wording (is it non-refundable?).
- Procurement will not sign price holds beyond 30 days without deposit. We'll request a 10% deposit to lock 30-day price protection.
- Also confirm whether OEM accepts multiple POs (one for initial racks, another for remaining). That helps cashflow for customer.

Marcus — could you pull estimated infra ops effort and staging window if we accept a 2-rack partial ship in early March? That will change staging costs and network setup.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quantilus Dedicated: OEM & Cloud capacity harmonization

Ben / team —

Preliminary infra notes:
- Staging 2 racks (16 cards) for early validation: estimate 3 engineers x 1.5 days each to install, test networking, and verify model parity (approx 36 engineer-hours).
- If racks are mixed precision (e.g., older generation), add 1 week for kernel/quantization regression checks.
- Networking: ACME cloud reservation needs to provide L3 adjacency in us-west-2 region; if the hardware is OEM-owned and colocated with ACME, add 48–72 hours for cross-connect provisioning.

I can draft a short runbook to capture these tasks for procurement and ops to agree to in the sync.

-Marcus
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
From: cloud-ops@acmecloud.com <cloud-ops@acmecloud.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@arc-gpu.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 07:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quantilus Dedicated: OEM & Cloud capacity harmonization

Connor / Lisa / Redwood team —

ACME capacity update: we can hold a soft reservation for up to 120 A100-equivalent GPUs in us-west-2 for 60 days (non-binding). If you need a contractual commitment, our committed-reservation SKU (CR-96) requires signed contract and 30% prepayment, with an 8-week lead to provision.

Network topology: CR-96 will be in a single availability cluster with low-latency spine links we can verify (expected p99 network hop < 600us to NVLink clusters). We will provide detailed topology drawings once the reservation is live.

Action items from our side for the call:
- Confirm which SKU (soft reserve vs CR-96) you want held.
- Provide anticipated start date; we will map provisioning timeline.

Regards,
ACME Cloud Ops
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@quantilus.ai>, Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@arc-gpu.com>, cloud-ops@acmecloud.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quantilus Dedicated: OEM & Cloud capacity harmonization

Samir / all —

Thanks for the quick turn on details. Short summary and asks so Procurement/Quantilus can action:
- OEM (Lisa): ARC-A100X-48 has a 9–11 week standard lead time. OEM can partial-ship racks at ~6 weeks with a 20% expedite surcharge and 2-rack minimum. Price hold 21 days, extendable to 30 with deposit. Please send the formal quote (SKU + serial plan + expedite terms) today so Procurement can prepare PO.
- ACME (cloud-ops): ACME will hold a soft reservation for up to 120 A100-eq GPUs for 60 days. To convert to contract (CR-96) requires signed contract + 30% prepay and 8-week provisioning. We need your commitment window for go/no-go.
- Redwood internal asks: Procurement (Ben) to prepare conditional PO template (two POs allowed: initial partial + remainder) and confirm acceptable deposit %; Ops (Marcus/Karthik) to draft a 1-page staging/runbook and estimate cutover ops costs.

Proposed mutual action plan (dates):
- Jan 18: OEM formal quote + ACME soft reserve confirmation (today)
- Jan 21: Quantilus to sign LOI to accept deposit terms (if they want 30-day price holds)
- Feb 5: Initial deposit processed / PO for initial racks (if LOI accepted)
- Mar 15: Target partial-production onramp (using partial racks + cloud reserve)

Samir — can you confirm by Jan 21 whether Quantilus will accept the 30% prepay or wants us to attempt alternate bridging (cloud-only) pricing? We need your preference to finalize which procurement path we push (OEM partial ship vs cloud contracted reserve).

Connor
